ops.title: Bound Landing holding incident-body query scope without losing body-only mentions
ops.description: Owner: /root/long_running_watch_flakes_ship. Separate fundamental issue assigned by Root after mq.py why installed697 source trace. Landing.holding7783 reads all open incident records on drive and expands every refs.path body before names_pr for each requested PR. Pending native1274 only changes CCI transport; it does not remove this Python body corpus read. Existing grades.names_pr honors structured refs OR body text, so blindly adding CCI --pr or rejecting a different structured ref can lose valid body-only mentions. Actual operation-level source/performance attribution and concrete existing API/index ownership design required before implementation. Narrow incremental binary fix ships independently; no new daemon/watch loop/timer, guessed cache freshness, migration or fallback. Next: exact reader/caller and existing indexed projection inspection; return bounded design preserving external append/file freshness and cross-PR mentions.

ops.text: Exact all-open-incident/body expansion ownership and existing native filter limitations are source-attributed with meaningful CI operation counts.

Root accepts a bounded shared/indexed ownership design preserving body-only PR mentions, concurrent append/file freshness and cross-drive semantics; exact implementation passes independent review and real caller CI.
Normal merge/publication/coordinated installation, natural adoption and affected operation proof complete without an overall host recovery claim.
